ctx.x: I'm the one that was getting the doubles, because I was playing drums, tympany, whatnot, even though they had the percussionists in there. But I'd have to go over sometime and hit a note. If I hit one, got to pay me. I wouldn't take that show unless they paid me well, with two doubles at the most -- I mean, at the least. Two doubles you got to give me, on top of my union salary. Yes, sir. I wouldn't take a Broadway show.
[Ernie Lawrence] spoiled me. Didn't I tell you about me marching in the march on Washington, with --
Oh, yeah, you mentioned that, but we're going to get to that just a little bit later.
